title: Voincs
tagline: A voting system using zero-knowledge proofs enables anonymous, secure voting without revealing individual choices.
description:
Introducing Our Revolutionary Voting System: Anonymity Meets Transparency

In today's digital age, security and privacy are more important than ever. Our mission is to create a voting system that upholds both anonymity and transparency, allowing every voice to be heard without fear of retribution or manipulation.

Leveraging the power of the Mina protocol and its zero-knowledge proof technology, our innovative voting system ensures that voters can cast their ballots without revealing their identities, while maintaining the integrity of the election process. The Mina protocol enables a public, decentralized ledger where each vote is recorded and verified by multiple nodes, eliminating the risk of centralized control or manipulation.
how_its_made: The system is developed using the snakyjs backend, a programming language. In this system, user information is handled with anonymity to ensure privacy. The primary function is to tally the yes/no responses provided by users. After collecting and processing these responses, the system calculates the total count and adds it to an ongoing chain, maintaining a record of all the responses over time.
